name: Milcah
overview: Milcah is a female figure from the tribe of Manasseh, uniquely identified as the daughter of Zelophehad. Her mention in Scripture is brief and specific, with no additional personal notes recorded. She is recognized within the genealogical records of the tribe of Manasseh.
namesAndTitles: The name Milcah is a proper name meaning "queen." This meaning is noted in the Hebrew context and is not indicated as being given directly by God. The name reflects a regal title but is simply presented as her given name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Milcah is explicitly identified as the daughter of Zelophehad, establishing her family relationship clearly in Scripture. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Milcah’s significance lies in her identification as one of the daughters of Zelophehad, a family noted within the tribe of Manasseh. Her mention preserves the lineage and inheritance rights associated with Zelophehad’s descendants, which is an important aspect of Israelite tribal history. While the text does not elaborate further on her role, her inclusion underscores the biblical record-keeping of tribal genealogies.
